Reckon Digital | Full-Stack Software Engineer | UK or remote | Python, React, AWS

We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Software Engineer to work with us on an upcoming project for a large humanitarian organisation. Required: Python, React, AWS, Postgres. The place of work is London, UK but we're open to remote applicants as well (UK or international).

More info on what we do at Reckon Digital: https://reckondigital.com/

Interested? Email us at jobs@reckondigital.com! Make sure you include an updated copy of your CV.
